_doc: Third batch of social encounters (npcs) and towns. See scripts/campaign/social.gd.

npcs.name: The Tide Clerk
npcs.greeting: Name. Boat. Weight. Of the dead. Aboard.
npcs.tell: Forms. Fees. Anything. That fits a box. Tears. Smudge. The ink.

hate: Do not. Drip. On my desk.

win.text: He stamps your hands. The tide reads it and lets you through dry.

lose.text: He files you under LOST AT SEA. The sea takes the hint.

npcs.name: The Salt Widower
npcs.greeting: She went. Paddling. Thirty years ago. Kettle's. Still on.
npcs.tell: He keeps. Her cup. Warm. Be kind. Be sorry. Money. Is what. The sea paid.

hit: Sit. Sit. Her chair. She won't mind.
hate: The sea. Paid me too. Keep it.
Shout. Shout then. She can't hear.
bribe: He drops it in the sink. Plink.

win.text: He gives you her swimming cap. It is still wet. It always will be.

lose.text: He opens the door to the sea and waits for you to go out it.

npcs.name: The Mason
npcs.greeting: Gargoyle. Number. Four hundred. Same face. Every time. Mine.
npcs.tell: Hard words. Hard coin. He carves. Hard things. Sweet talk. Crumbles.

win.text: He carves your faces on the next gargoyle. It watches your back.

lose.text: He drops the scaffold. Accident. Accident. Write it down.

npcs.name: The Candle Girl
npcs.greeting: One candle. One wish. One person. Who isn't. Coming back.
npcs.tell: She likes. Pretty words. Pretty lies. Coins are. For the dead.

hate: Coins. On eyes. Not in hands.
bribe: She lights a candle with it. For you. Early.

win.text: She lights one for each of you. Yours burn very slowly.

lose.text: She lights one for each of you. Yours are already short.

npcs.name: The Ossuary Keeper
npcs.greeting: Every skull. Has a number. Numbers. Get. Called.
npcs.tell: He only. Trusts. The begging. The dead beg. Liars. Smile. Like skulls.

bribe: He tucks it in an eye socket.

win.text: He lends you a skull. It knows the way through. It clicks when you go wrong.

lose.text: He gives one of you a number. Shelf space is. Available.

npcs.name: The Tally Man
npcs.greeting: Tally. Tally. Tokens in. Men out. Count. Doesn't. Match.
npcs.tell: He likes. Weight. In a fist. In a palm. Begging. Wastes. Shift time.

win.text: He crosses your names off the missing list. Somebody else goes on it.

lose.text: He docks you. Wages. Then blood.

npcs.name: The Canary Keeper
npcs.greeting: Shh. Shh. They stopped. Singing. Tuesday.
npcs.tell: Gentle. Gentle. Like. With birds. Loud. Kills them. So does. Fibbing.

hate: They know. When you lie. They drop.
bribe: He buys seed. For birds that don't eat.

win.text: He gives you one bird. It sings before the bad air. And before the bad things.

lose.text: The bird stops singing. So does your breath, for a bit.

npcs.name: The Lamp Man
npcs.greeting: Lamp. Number. Yours? No. That's. A dead man's.
npcs.tell: He likes. Stories. True ones. Bore him. Money. Is what. The lamps cost. Lives.

like: Light. Light. That's. A good one.

win.text: He hands you a lamp. On its tag, a number from a bingo card. It never goes out.

lose.text: He turns your lamps down. The dark down there has teeth.

npcs.name: Seat Fourteen
npcs.greeting: Eyes down. Eyes. Down. I'm waiting. On one number. Since. Since.
npcs.tell: She sat. With Pauline. With Steve. Nobody asks. About them. Ask. Lies. She marks. In red.

bribe: She puts it under her card. For bus fare. Home.

win.text: She gives you her lucky dauber. 'I won't. Be needing it. He never calls it.'

lose.text: She calls him over. 'This one's. Talking. During the call.'

npcs.name: The Raffle Woman
npcs.greeting: Pink ticket? Blue? Blue's. Better. Blue. Wins.
npcs.tell: Buy a strip. Tell her. You feel lucky. Shouting. Spoils. The draw.

bribe: A strip of five. And one. For luck.

win.text: Your number comes up. The prize is from the back of the cupboard. It's warm.

lose.text: Your number comes up. The prize is you.

npcs.name: The Last Regular
npcs.greeting: Coat. On the chair. Card. Half done. Bus. Was at ten. What. Year.
npcs.tell: He just. Wants. To be. Let go home. Ask him. Nicely. Money. Means. Nothing. Now.

hit: The bus. Is that. The bus?
like: You'll. Tell my wife. I tried.
hate: Money. Money. I had. A pound. A pound for. The bus.
Don't. He hears. He always. Hears.
bribe: He tucks it in his card. Like a bookmark. For later.

win.text: He stands. First time in years. Somewhere a chair scrapes. He leaves his card. Every number marked but one.

lose.text: He sits back down. 'Eyes down,' he says. You find you have sat down too.

npcs.name: The Debt Collector
npcs.greeting: Outstanding. Balance. Yours. Your. Parents'. Further back.
npcs.tell: Pay. Or. Stand firm. He respects. A ledger. Excuses. Compound.

win.text: He tears up the page. Underneath, an older page. Also yours. He tears that too.

lose.text: He collects. Not gold. Gold is. Easier.

npcs.name: The Second
npcs.greeting: My principal. Is dead. I still. Owe him. A duel.
npcs.tell: Courage. Courtesy. A second. Lives for them. Cheats. Die. At dawn.

bribe: He flips it. Calls it. Wrong. Keeps it.

win.text: He teaches you the thing his principal never learned. Too late, for him.

lose.text: He throws a glove. Dawn comes early.

npcs.name: The Night Nurse
npcs.greeting: Visiting hours. Ended. In nineteen. Eighty. Something.
npcs.tell: Tell her. You're family. Or beg. Like family. Raise. Your voice. And.

like: Oh. Oh, you're his. Son. Of course.
hate: We don't. Shout. On this ward.
bribe: She pockets it. Writes you in. As next of kin.

win.text: She lets you sleep in the empty beds. They're still warm.

lose.text: She gives you something. To help you. Rest.

towns.name: Saltmarsh Wake
towns.intro: Saltmarsh. Houses. On stilts. The tide comes. Into. The kitchens. Two bells.

places.name: The Tide Office
places.desc: A desk. In the water. Up to the drawers.

places.name: The Net Loft
places.desc: Nets. Hooks. What the nets caught.

places.name: The Drying Racks
places.text: You dry. Mostly. Your boots never will.

places.name: The Wreck Chapel
places.desc: A hull turned over. Pews inside. 10 gold.
places.text: The hymn numbers on the board are bingo numbers. Somebody has dabbed them.
places.poor_text: The collection plate. Looks at you.

towns.name: Saint Callum's Close
towns.intro: The Close. Little houses. In the cathedral's. Shadow. It's always. Shadow. Two bells.

places.name: The Mason's Yard
places.desc: Hammering. Same face. Over and over.

places.name: The Font
places.text: Your reflections are wearing paper faces. Then they aren't.

places.name: The Lych Gate

effects.text: Bounty: land two critical hits next fight

places.desc: A notice. Nailed to the gate.
places.text: Under the bounty, older notices. MISSING. MISSING. The faces are regulars.

towns.name: Pithead Row
towns.intro: Pithead Row. Terraced. Soot. The cage. Goes down. Comes up. Lighter. Two bells.

places.name: The Tally Office
places.desc: Brass tokens. On hooks. Some hooks empty.

places.name: The Company Store
places.desc: Prices. In scrip. Scrip. In blood.

places.name: The Pithead Baths
places.text: The water runs black. Then clear. Then black again.

places.name: The Winding Gear
places.desc: Somebody's left something. In the teeth.
places.text: You pull it out. The cog bites back.

towns.name: The Annex
towns.intro: The Annex. Behind the hall. Where the regulars. Wait. For their lift. Home. Two bells.

places.name: The Prize Cupboard
places.desc: A bear. A radio. A ham. Reserved.

places.name: Lost Property
places.text: In every pocket: a bus ticket. Same night. Same bus.

places.name: The Car Park
places.text: Keys in every ignition. Moss on every seat. You take the change from the ashtrays.

places.name: The Tea Hatch
places.text: The urn is full. It has been. Full. Since the last night.

towns.name: The All-Night Stop
towns.intro: Lights. On the road. A stop. That's. Open. All night. Every night. Two bells.

places.name: The Back Booth
places.desc: A man. Two glasses. One full.

places.name: The Bus Shelter
places.desc: Somebody. Waiting. For the ten o'clock.

places.name: The Payphone
places.text: A woman's voice. 'Is Pauline there? She said. Ten. She said.' Then numbers. Read slowly.

places.name: A Room
places.text: The wallpaper is a bingo card. Big. Your bed. Is on a number.
places.poor_text: The desk clerk. Doesn't. Look up.
